description: This file defines an API client class for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) and handling API exceptions. It also defines a custom exception class for HTTP errors. The ApiClient relies on environment variables for configuration and supports authorization headers via a token supplier.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Represents an HTTP error response with status and message.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Provides helper methods for making HTTP requests to a REST API, including GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE, with support for authorization headers and configurable base URL.

methods.name: ApiClient.get
methods.description: Performs a GET request and returns parsed JSON or null if the response is empty.

methods.name: ApiClient.post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with an optional JSON body and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: ApiClient.patch
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request with an optional JSON body and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: ApiClient.delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request with an optional JSON body and returns parsed JSON if present.
